Screen mirroring from iPhone or iPad
Open Control Center, tap Screen Mirroring and pick “%1$s”.\nThe screen and sound go to the TV. To end, tap Stop Mirroring in Control Center.
In Apple Music, YouTube, iQiyi and other apps, tap the AirPlay icon while playing and pick “%1$s”.\nThe TV plays video straight from the internet, so your phone can lock or do something else.

Bilibili, iQiyi, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and other apps have their own cast button (usually a TV icon). Tap it and pick “%1$s”.\nWorks from iPhone and Android phones, with DLNA casting on in Settings.
Cast video and music with apps\' own cast button, as in “Apps\' own cast button”.\nAndroid\'s built-in screen mirroring (Miracast, Google Cast) isn\'t supported yet.

Click Control Center in the menu bar → Screen Mirroring and pick “%1$s”.\nMusic from the Mac’s Music app can’t be sent to CastBay: it uses an encryption the open-source AirPlay library doesn’t support.

Video: OK pauses or resumes; Left and Right skip back or ahead 10 seconds.
Music: Left and Right choose a button; OK presses it.
Down or Menu: the playback menu (picture, audio, subtitles, lyrics…).
Back twice: stop casting. Home: keep playing in the background.

Tap the screen: the playback menu (picture, audio, subtitles, lyrics; for videos, pause and skip). It closes by itself after a few seconds.
Music: tap the buttons to pause or change tracks.
Media buttons (a steering wheel's, for example): play/pause, next and previous track.
Back twice: stop casting.

Your phone can\'t find this TV?

• Connect the phone and TV to the same Wi-Fi, not a guest network.
• Check that CastBay is open, showing “Waiting for a connection”.
• If the router has “AP isolation” on, devices can't see each other; turn it off.
• Reopen CastBay or restart the TV and try again.
AirPlay and DLNA videos are fetched by the TV itself. If your phone needs a proxy or VPN to open them (e.g. YouTube), so does the TV.
The first time a device casts, it enters a PIN shown on the TV; after that it is remembered.

Blocked devices can’t cast. Removed devices are new again: the next time they cast, they are confirmed or enter a PIN, as chosen above.
“%1$s” wants to cast to this TV
You can change this later in Settings.
Cast again from the device to start.
The first time a device casts, it must be allowed on the TV, then cast again.

Choose in Settings → Connection → Casting verification:
• Confirm: the first time a device casts, the TV asks whether to allow it; once allowed, cast again from the device.
• PIN: the first time a device casts, enter the 4-digit PIN the TV shows.
• Password: every device enters the password set in Settings.
Under “Devices that have cast”, you can block a device, or remove them all.
